prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. The picture contains itself: the stairwell spiralling down shows the same scene again, smaller, which holds it again, smaller and smaller, spiralling inwards forever. Camera high, looking straight down the well of a tenement stairwell that spirals down into the dark. On the top landing, close to the lens, a landlord in a fur collar holds out his open palm; far below, the baker climbs, pay packet in hand. Peeling paint, iron banisters. Light: one bare bulb on each landing, each a small pool of yellow; the rest in deep shadow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
